question: Who among the following political leaders succeeded Venkaiah Naidu to become Vice President of India in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jagdeep Dhankhar.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Former West Bengal governor & National Democratic Alliance (NDA) candidate Jagdeep Dhankhar was elected the 14th Vice President of India on 6 August 2022.
 
• Mr Dhankhar defeated the Opposition’s candidate, Ms Margaret Alva, by a margin of 346 votes.
 
• He will succeed M Venkaiah Naidu.
 
• Mr Dhankhar will take the oath of office on 11 August 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Bhagat Singh Koshyari **is a politician and a former Chief Minister of Uttarakhand. He was appointed as the** Governor of Maharashtra in September 2019.**
 
• ** Arif Mohammed Khan** is a politician and a former Member of Parliament. He was appointed as the** Governor of Kerala in September 2019.**
 
• **Biswabhusan Harichandan** is a politician and a former Minister in the Government of Odisha. He was appointed as the** Governor of Andhra Pradesh in July 2019.**
